subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale reasoning from breaking later turns

question: Should Copilot replay preserve complete reasoning during a proven active process session, or should encrypted reasoning always be stripped at the provider boundary?
rationale: The current PR, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95493, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95587 encode materially different continuity and recovery policies; tests cannot determine the intended long-term provider contract.

options.title: Preserve proven active reasoning
options.body: Keep this PR’s cold-versus-active policy, move active admission after provider success, and require live cold-resume, tool-continuation, and streamed-recovery proof.

options.title: Always strip encrypted reasoning
options.body: Use a narrow Copilot boundary policy like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95493, accepting reduced reasoning continuity to eliminate token-lineage replay risk.

options.title: Split recovery from policy
options.body: Land generic stream-drain recovery separately and pause the Copilot lifecycle policy until provider behavior is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Preserve proven active reasoning
recommendation.body: Keep this PR’s cold-versus-active policy, move active admission after provider success, and require live cold-resume, tool-continuation, and streamed-recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged or authored the central Copilot replay, shared provenance, and invalid-signature recovery history.
